task_specification.objective: Repair the ordinary wave director and Bellkeeper lifecycle, restore bounded automatic lantern attack audio, and instrument/stabilize dense native rendering so the three required release-convergence gaps are ready for host recapture while preserving native boot/project baselines and the authored cemetery presentation.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three independent release-convergence defects remain: ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper progression is fixture-assisted, automatic lantern attacks lack audible Effects-bus causality, and dense native-renderer performance is unqualified. Arena readability is deferred as an issue, but the host-mandated spatial capability still needs explicit same-loop acceptance.

stop_conditions: Keep scope to the three required gaps plus the two host-mandated player capabilities.
Do not create a separate task for deferred finding.arena_exposure_readability or backlog-only gaps.
Leave runtime evidence capture, formal retest, issue closure, and phase verdict to GameLoop Runtime/Tester.

strategy.rationale: Partition implementation into wave/lifecycle plus mandated spatial/choice acceptance, combat-audio causality, and dense-performance families. Use candidate-side repairs and ordinary-runtime paths instead of fixture-only evidence, while preserving the native project, host boot, and retained authored assets.

code: Run existing Godot/native boot and integrity checks and static/source checks for all modified scripts/resources/scenes; verify no parser/runtime errors and preserve project configuration.

Exercise ordinary route, spatial traversal, upgrade draft focus, AUTO attack audio, and dense profile with deterministic replays; compare state identifiers, attack-event counts, focus states, collision/visibility checks, and performance receipts before/after.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester recaptures the required MCP evidence for ordinary five-wave progression and Bellkeeper Result/Retry, authored arena traversal and choice focus, mixed Effects-bus AUTO transient causality, and dense native-renderer stress metrics across three retries.
Tester performs direct black-box plus white-box retests, confirms native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation, and owns issue closure and release-convergence verdict.
visual: Capture sparse gameplay frames for spawn, mid-wave, cardinal/landmark traversal, Bellkeeper arena, Result/Retry, upgrade draft, AUTO fire peak, and dense profile; ensure diagnostics are not HUD-visible, retained cemetery composition remains intact, silhouettes and telegraphs stay readable, and no disappearance/occlusion or boundary regressions appear.

done_when: A normal player run advances through five authored waves without tester fixtures, with authoritative receipts for each transition and Bellkeeper spawning only from the normal director path.
Bellkeeper defeat reaches Result and Retry/reset returns to a clean run; no transition depends on synthetic setup or hidden tester actions.

The arena has larger traversable scale with a coherent external world/depth, a readable central building/landmark, aligned visible geometry and collision, and no disappearance or camera occlusion during ordinary movement; the boundary/perimeter remains visible and impassable in movement replay.

Upgrade/weapon choices lead with authored silhouettes/icons and a compact visual hierarchy, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged/placeholder rows, and expose complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
Tester can directly replay movement/combat and inspect state/log output to verify wave 1→5, boss spawn, defeat, Result, Retry, spatial collision/visibility, and choice focus behavior.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative wave director, spawn pacing, boss trigger, defeat, Result, and Retry lifecycle for a normal five-wave cemetery run. Rebase spawn/objective/collision/navigation on the authored cemetery streets and expand to a larger traversable scale with an external world/depth and stable central building/landmark visibility; verify collision alignment, no disappearance or occlusion, and a visible impassable boundary/perimeter under ordinary movement and movement replay. Ensure upgrade/weapon draft presentation uses an authored visual hierarchy with silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new deltas capped at three, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus without placeholder values. Remove fixture-only assumptions from the shipped path, drive transitions from live gameplay state, and expose stable state identifiers/receipts for Tester probes without adding release-visible tester controls. Preserve authored map assets and native boot bindings.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary route with spatial and choice integrity

done_when: One lantern AUTO attack and a quick AUTO tap each emit exactly one short, recognizable firearm-like transient on mixed Effects output, tied to the attack event.

Sustained AUTO starts only after cadence-valid continuation and stops on release and lifecycle reset; miss, concrete-hit, character-hit, metal, and retained component/native report stems remain distinct and long ringing impacts cannot mask the report.
Tester can rerun the same audio probe and inspect runtime timeline/logs plus mixed output to verify bounded duration and causality.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned automatic lantern attack audio adapter and routing so player AUTO attacks produce one bounded transient on the Effects bus. Trace weapon-controller events through the related combat feedback presenter; isolate report, miss, concrete-hit, metal, and character-hit stems, constrain envelopes/levels, and suppress unsafe world-surface impact audio when no reliable short cue exists. Preserve the retained component firearm path, profile/hierarchy, transforms, and recoil/timing; generic shot VFX must not replay the complete retained recording. Keep the attack chain cooldown-ready → legal target → emitted attack → hit resolution → damage/death/drop causally inspectable.
tasks.title: Restore causal automatic lantern attack transient

done_when: The representative dense high-enemy/high-VFX native run emits stable frame-time, draw/instance, and lifecycle-allocation snapshots that host qualification can consume.

The scenario remains playable and avoids unbounded per-frame allocations, duplicate effect nodes, and stale entities across wave transitions, reset, and Result; diagnostics stay out of release HUD/export presentation.
Tester can replay the same bounded stress scenario and compare before/after metrics from candidate receipts across three complete retries.
tasks.instructions: Close the dense native-renderer performance gap with candidate-side profiling hooks and focused lifecycle/per-frame cost reductions in swarm, projectile/VFX, and wave-reset paths. Eliminate duplicate processing, avoidable allocations, and stale node retention without changing gameplay behavior or readability. Emit structured performance snapshots only through existing diagnostics paths and guard them from release HUD/export visibility; retain the native 1920x1080 three-cycle qualification contract for host recapture.
